name: Association Rules (Apriori / Market Basket)
when_to_use: Transactions with item sets (e.g., shopping cart); find item combinations that appear together more often than a minimum support/confidence.
notes: Finds item combinations that tend to appear together in the same transaction. Applications: "customers who buy X also buy Y" in retail/e-commerce.

expected_input.question: Which items tend to appear together in the same transaction?

plain_explanation.purpose: Discovers what tends to appear together ('whoever takes A also takes B').
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are item lists per transaction and you want to find frequent combinations.
plain_explanation.data_needed: List of transactions, each with the items it contains.
plain_explanation.example: Discover which products are bought together.
